name: shipping_fee

source.name: Original
source.modifications: Authored for this experiment as a multi-module parcel and shipping fee package with shared weight conversion, parcel parsing, rate tables, fee calculation and batch helpers.

issue: 调用 parse_parcel 或 shipping_fee 处理以克为单位的包裹时，重量没有换算成千克。例如 2000 克被当作 2000 千克，north 区域标准运费返回 5005.00 元，期望 10.00 元。请修复该问题，并保持千克与磅换算、区域附加费、加急倍率、批量统计和非法输入校验的行为不变。
notes: The grams branch of the shared to_kilograms helper returns the raw value. Both parse_parcel and shipping_fee call the helper, so the failure appears in two public paths. Regression tests use kilograms or zero grams and pass in both states.
